notes.title: Fallen Aces the crime noir FPS is now Steam Deck Verified with the Wheels of Steel update
notes.content: Fallen Aces from Trey Powell, Jason Bond and New Blood Interactive looks awesome and now it should be even better. With the Wheels of Steel update there's been a few bits added, overhauled and now it's Steam Deck Verified too.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/fallen-aces-the-crime-noir-fps-is-now-steam-deck-verified-with-the-wheels-of-steel-update/

notes.title: The Wheels of Steel Update
notes.content:
AY OH, IT'S 2025 ALREADY?! WELL WOULD YA LOOK AT THAT. 

GUESS WE BETTER GET BACK TO WORK ON DA GAME, BOSS! 

TAKE A LOOKIN AT WHAT WE BEEN COOKIN.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/2ab079d060bacd457c1e6073a7e59dd0269c1131.png

General improvements:


 Fixed enemies falling through moving geometry after loading a save.
 If an enemy gets stuck trying to move through another, they'll be allowed to move temporarily.
 Enemies will avoid pathing to the same position, instead opting to move closeby if another enemy is moving to or at that position.
 Every path calculation should be asynchronous now.
 Enemies won't ragdoll for short falls anymore and will instead enter a "short fall" state.
 Enemies will fall if you break geometry from under them.
 Hopefully fixed fire pushing enemies away if it spawns at their feet.
 Shitting goon can navigate off the toilet better. (IMPORTANT!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/90a10e52f38c7163609c8d1f74f58b7b2b1c4acd.png
Hideout:


 Adjusted Blake dialogue triggers to prevent buggy behaviour. 
 You can now hit Nightwave and he'll react.
 Blake now reacts to you hitting him. (stop that)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/4dcff1a08d1c0f927aeba98901549e2e7c2a3318.png

User Interface:


 Updated text and some UI elements to be bigger on steam deck.
 Better controller navigation in profile menu.
 Enabled rename and delete profile buttons on steam deck.
 Added options to change status effect card and enemy healthbar size in accessibility menu on PC.
 Improved sliders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/b4879271e032f12cf49d982607a277ab0254e2a2.png

Lighter:


 Slighty higher radius.
 Faster light.
 Removed strobe effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/dcdceeb14ecb21a40d825b4f109867d87f565719.png

Audio:


 Fixed fire sfx stopping after save/load.
 Fixed audio glitch when the camera exits water in level 2 intro.
 Fixed music not playing after stopping a stinger abruptly.
 Fixed event-triggered ambience not playing after loading a save.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/c02ff2356337a8d09d415fb55b267e98d3e426d6.jpg

Other changes:


 Fixed buggy behaviour when enemies are fighting eachother.
 Fixed Mike's hands staying up after death if they were in the middle of a kick animation.
 Fixed equipped item display not updating sprite correctly when breaking a bottle.
 Fixed being able to press R to restart while a menu is open leading to buggy behaviour.
 Fixed circle screen transition moving too fast when a frame takes too long.
 Fixed action cooldown being too short when using nailgun melee with bolt.
 Fixed corpses on fire perpetually spreading fire to other corpses.
 Fixed death by throttlin' not triggering taunt lines.
 Snipers can now target enemy faction members.
 Enemies now need to fall further to take fall damage.
 Thrown bodies now deal more damage to breakable doors, allowing you to throw an enemy through them.
 Player kicks now deal more damage to props and breakable geometry.
 Projectiles now pass through decorative corpses and they'll rotate to face the camera better.
 Molotov mook will try to avoid throwing a molotov if it'll hit their buddies, however he'll still hit them if they move into where the molotov lands after it's thrown.
 Smoke from fire now avoids going through the ceiling.
 Allow sprinting with bodies when using Bolt.
 New vehicle models.
 New machinegun mook sprites.
 Machinegun mook can now walk.
 Some new oneliners for Mike.
 New punch & automatic pistol sfx.
 Map updates/fixes.
 Lighting updates/fixes.
 Added fall damage to Delia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/3721b61f272a0651485dcc7a866133a9036fd9fa.jpg

SO WHATS DA BIG DEAL HERE?
Well as you can see in additon to all the little fixes and changes and big old green Steam Deck Check we've remade EVERY SINGLE AUTOMOBILE ASSET IN THE GAME (Thanks to DUSK HD creator, Garumin) and that there Tommy Gun goon got all new animations, too. Nice.

So what's next?

Well we've already got Episode 2 all storyboarded out and into production but before dat we're gonna give all yous da Level Editor and Steam Workshop so you can make your own Fallen Aces levels and leave us the hell alone while we work on the game! Sound good?

WE THOUGHT SO.

See yas SOON™

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1411910/Fallen_Aces/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47671/The_New_Blood_Stealth_Trilogy/
https://i.imgur.com/jFoLcGV.png

Fallen Aces - The Hideout Update 

Major Additions:

 Added Hideout, post-mission conversations, firing range
 Added Profile system for tracking player actions, money, and progress 
 Added new upgrades available from Blake’s shop in the Hideout (Lunch Box, Ammo Pouch)
 Added hidden collectible comic books
 Added new enemy… 

Fixes and Improvements:

 Extra detailing on Level 5, new reflections and set dressing
 Fixed issue where enemies could fall down and become stuck falling (...forever)
 Fixed issue with incorrect secret counts on some levels 
 Added slightly transparent background to subtitle text to improve readability
 Rearranged HUD elements to make room for new gadgets and decrease clutter
 Added accessibility option to make QTEs hold instead of tap 
 Fixed issue where Goons and Pipeguys wouldn’t throw their weapons in the direction of the player
 Fixed issue with uppercase naming of custom difficulties and profiles
 Fixed various z-fighting, underlay, and dev texture issues 
 Various improvements to controller navigation 
 Improved inventory scrolling to accommodate Lunch Box and Ammo Pouch upgrades

notes.title: Thank Yous and Updates!
notes.content:
Holy cannoli, what a week it's been for us ovah here at New Blood.

Over 70,000 goons whalloped, over 2000 Overwhelmingly Positive reviews!

WE DID PRETTY GOOD, EH?!

But we ain't even begun, kiddos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/f4703b0410c16381a117f4d331a77acc50b35b94.png

First things first, we got an update for ya - and it's out... RIGHT NOW!

We got autosaves!
The game will now save every time an objective is updated (and even some other places) so you ain't gonna lose no more progress! But just in case, don't forget to use dem F6 and F9 keys, alright?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/ab8dd4269a813a2b30262b8a6792e10097fa266f.png
We now got slots for Quicksaves, Autosaves and Manual Saves, ordered automatically by your most recent - you can even delete dem saves! 

Unfortunately some of your saves ain't gonna work no more because we've made some level changes, but your progress is gonna be all good, boss!

We also got some new options!
We got crouch toggle and sprint toggle! (for those of ya with dem old fingers)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/2ab3eb94c9d559ff70d333573dcf223ed6e2293e.png
You can even disable controller support now so your racing wheel don't somehow start spinning when you start up Nightwave's car, hah!

Speaking of Nightwave
We moved his dog food eatin' ass up higher in Level 2 so he can snipe more goons! Ya welcome!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/7395e8e895ecc5b1f2432acc0431e7b461f4c9a5.png
We've also updated the map and boat objectives a bit to make it a bit easier to figure out what ya gotta do in that level. Happy, detective?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/426a8810863248ead4087811adaa87111ab7cce7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/c4221d7cd957b2125c5021e90697bf0dd3c8a77d.png
We also made some small adjustments to levels 3, 4 and 5 plus fixed plenty of bugs. 

Go have a look, see if ya can spot what we "made better" wise guy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/9d1c71849f7e1b3b40d1fc24b84b426be7403ebf.jpg
Now we also heard some of yous saying the game was TOO EASY?!

Well guess what, tough guy - we made hard mode harder!

But that's not all...

WE GOT CUSTOM DIFFICULTY NOW.
Go ahead! Make the game as hard or as easy as ya want. Want Mike to do no damage? heheh good luck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/2547c9d2a5d43c0917d13ad3b953386eccd4bfdf.png
Want Mike to kill everyone in one hit and have blind goons stand around all day looking for im? Go nuts!

It's a video game, kiddo - we're not the boss of ya!

That's what we got for ya today...

HERE'S WHAT WE'RE WORKING ON NEXT
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/e05e35029439db6276f2fb016ba2da79defdb1cc.png
What's that? It's Nightwave's garage ya dumb palooka!

This will be where Mike will be able to go between missions to stock up on food, ammo, weapons, health items and eventually spend all that money on UPGRADES.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/8cc29355c3ef7bcf291690d59f6cdbd6c1e9021d.png
That's right, we'll let ya carry more stuff, do more damage, take less damage, maybe even give Mike an ammo pouch and a little lunchbox! heheh

Will it have a shooting range? OF COURSE IT'LL HAVE A SHOOTING RANGE WHAT SORTA VIDEO GAME DO YOU THINK THIS IS WHY I OUGHTTAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

ANYWAY...
We're also working on the Secret Level for Episode 1, having our old buddy Andrew Hulshult do an audio pass on things like the cutscenes, working on getting new enemies and weapons into the game and even some more civilians you can terrorize! (or help, ya lunatic)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/e8daa3f566bd16c1ac22a9625ee07f4fb28fdbe0.jpg
This is of course in addition to our upcoming Level Editor and Steam Workshop support, as well as a new demo!

Oh and for all yous complaining about the game not running on that there Steam Deck, don't worry - WE'RE WORKIN ON ITTTTTTTT

(Until then you can find plenty of workarounds for Steam Deck on the forums that seem to work so far!)

Thanks so much for the love you've all shown us guys and gals ovah here at New Blood. 

You know we work hard to bring you that good shit! 

Talk SOON™ you goons.

notes.title: Da Launch Plans!
notes.content:
Hey there all yous gabagoons!

So unless you been living under a rock - you should know that we just announced that Fallen Aces: Episode 1 will be out THIS WEEK. FRIDAY, JUNE 14TH. 

[previewyoutube=vTWta2kwHzM;full][/previewyoutube]
When?!

Should be in the morning. Might be at night. Sometime on Friday, alright.

What are we getting?!

All of Episode 1! (there's 3 episodes total) 

It's got FIVE BIG LEVELS with lots of replayability, a ton of weapons and ways to play em and fully hand drawn and voice acted comic book style cutscenes like you can see in that there trailer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/4dec48c8e5fa68662401292faf2a11719fa2d11b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/14d5037da463c734986d999fa968ba338d68237d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/c8ae120e742382e56092fd2c2db73351d3611bfc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/420e7c7338c340752544999af29a513987b48655.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/562a468fe22cd5d199d753da26065ff403309508.png
It's a BIG PALOOKA of an Early Access launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/a11dc139e979c8180486a68bca053efc1e32ea65.png
What do we get after that?

Well well well, after we're happy with the Episode 1 launch and we do some updates based on YOUR feedback - we'll be expanding and iterating on the game but also releasing our FULL LEVEL EDITOR later this year along with STEAM WORKSHOP SUPPORT. How bout dat?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/e7d662f48099bc49da29c9fdfdcc43da3f1b9313.png
That should keep you goons busy while we work on Episode 2, eh?

What about the demo?

That thing is OLD, man. Like seriously old as a rusty trombone. It's still good though so we've left it up but we'll be getting rid of it once Early Access starts! The game is so much better and different now, you're not gonna believe it. Trust da boss on this one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/5c9988abcf2661ed661c49ff7525c2e69f3ba45c.png
Will there be a new demo?

Maybe! Not yet though cuz we're busy polishing up Episode 1 for launch and working on the level editor and Steam Workshop support - but we do love free stuff - so if ya ask real nice maybe we'll do a new one down the line.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/34b79c509317ea44db4e6991583e5bdb4262b21f.png
But I know what ya really wanna know...

THE PRICE!

Oh you guys aren't gonna believe this.

You ready for this?

Fallen Aces will launch with the full first episode out for just $12.99

That's right, just $XIII - GET IT?!

And better yet, with that there launch discount it'll be just $9.99 USD.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/0c3507a1b5241176992d8ad1836217e68d267aba.png
WHAT A MEAL

That $10 Early Access price gets you the full game and everything we're gonna do with it for the next few years. Are we crazy? Maybe. But we love you and we hate money. That's like our whole motto or whatever! The price WILL go up for Episode 2 and 3 though so buy now and save!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/fb7a7acce9ee5d174c6ee56f41bc2962de7bce89.jpg
We also want something more important than that cashola. We want PLAYERS. We wanna build dis game with you just like we've done with our other games like DUSK, AMID EVIL, ULTRAKILL and GLOOMWOOD. 

We want that feedback. We want that help balacing difficulty. We wanna know what kinda weapons and executions you wanna see Mike use. We want all dem suggestions. CAPICHE?!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38693071/bd7f75cb78fe8143930bf336e228e88c6978a7e0.png
So anyway, if ya still haven't - don't be a wiseguy and wishlist and follow the game to know EXACTLY when it's out. You're gonna love it.

Sincerely, 

- Mr. Gabagool (Dave)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1411910/Fallen_Aces/
